annotations.title: Corporate series vs Polish treasury savings bonds

description: Compare one PLN Catalyst series held to maturity with each Polish retail treasury savings bond of the current offer (OTS, ROR, DOR, TOS, COI, EDO, ROS, ROD) held to its maturity: amount invested, interest, tax, net payout, gross and net annual yield, with the series closest in term marked. Treasury rates after the first period depend on inflation and the NBP rate: they are assumptions (defaults given, user can change them). Corporate price comes from the user (100% assumed if not given). Descriptive calculation, not advice. Porównanie serii z obligacjami skarbowymi po podatku.

account.description: regular = 19% tax on interest (default); ike = IKE/IKZE, no tax on interest.

code.description: Catalyst code of a PLN series, e.g. "KRU0632".

inflation_pct.description: Assumed yearly inflation for inflation-linked treasury bonds from year 2, % (default: last GUS reading used by our calculator).

nbp_rate_pct.description: Assumed NBP reference rate for ROR/DOR, % (default: current rate).

price_pct.description: Clean price of the corporate series in % of face value, from the user (default 100, stated as an assumption).

name: compare_with_treasury
title: Corporate series vs Polish treasury savings bonds
